study: Actual short-r1 response-span decomposition from immutable saved vectors

arithmetic.mixed: post_update_logprobs(no-grad) - before_update_logprobs(pre-grad); retained for comparison only
arithmetic.legacy: Each token contributes A*delta/selected_action_tokens/4; fixed original raw sequence rho optionally multiplies it. Actual loss-dtype rounded-rho variant is also saved.
arithmetic.fixed_scale: Rescale the same saved delta as A*delta/128/4, optionally with the same fixed raw rho. This is a descriptive counterfactual normalization, not a trained new-mode result or new probability evaluation.
arithmetic.fixed_action_mass: The saved evidence has two complete mixed pairs (2+2) and one singleton; four actions coincide with all complete-group mass in this old file.
arithmetic.controls: Native control tokens and ordinary thought-header tokens remain sampled/loss-selected in all four historical actions. None is retrospectively masked out.
arithmetic.objective_decomposition: Also evaluate the historical exact FP64 PPO-clipped + .02*k3 token formula with fixed old/reference/rho, and descriptively rescale identical terms by128. These are vector-derived analytic reconstructions, not observed GPU scalar evaluations; comparing different normalizations is not a training improvement.

proposed_head_selection.action_order: First two eligible actions in the frozen prepare_rows order; do not select by reward sign, observed delta, gradient or head discrepancy.
slots_in_priority_order: lower median of sampled true thought-body tokens
lower median of sampled native tool-body tokens
last selected token in the response, usually a sampled native tool-close control
proposed_head_selection.dedup_and_fallback: Deduplicate preserving slot priority. If fewer than min(4, selected_count), append unseen full-selected ranks floor((n-1)*q) for q=0,1/3,2/3,1 until4 or all n; return chosen rows in temporal selected-index order.
proposed_head_selection.native_boundary_rule: Recognize channel/tool controls by pinned raw IDs100/101/48/49; identify the lexical thought header by decoding its existing raw IDs through the native newline107, without re-tokenization. Thought body begins after that header and ends before101. A tool-open48 counts only outside thought, and tool body runs until49 outside thought, excluding native delimiter/quote IDs. Do not treat quoted tool controls inside thought as an emitted tool call.
proposed_head_selection.fallback_boundary: If a valid thought/tool span is absent or its selected set empty, skip that slot and use the full-selected quantile fallback; never invent rows/coefficients or score mask0. Zero selected tokens are already ineligible upstream.
proposed_head_selection.coefficient_mapping: Apply selected_index_0 to returned predictor rows, selected targets and the retained current.grad upstream coefficients from that same actual forward. completion_index_0 and predictor_sequence_index_0 are source audit coordinates, not substitutes for selected_index when masks have gaps.
proposed_head_selection.declaration_scope: Prospective deterministic rule for pending zero-optimizer GPU head diagnostics, designed using old pilot token structures before pending GPU results. This does not alter training loss, sample admission, advantage, old/reference or the default algorithm.
proposed_head_selection.captured_prior_coverage: Current numerics head study chooses first4 selected predictors from first action only. In all four short-r1 responses, these are channel-open, thought label, newline and the first thought word. They provide no tool-body/argument coverage.
proposed_head_selection.limitation: At most8 detached head rows from two actions; preserves the existing head-isolation bound and its full-focal-shape/backbone/CUDA limitations. It is not an exhaustive token or task diagnostic.

limitations: Four selected mixed-group actions only; source/task population concentration is not estimated.
No post-grad vector was saved; this analysis cannot infer same-grad finite-step change or its root cause.
No model, optimizer, probability re-scoring, sample consumption, training, GPU, heldout or source/config change.

findings.concentration: Thought body has423/545 selected tokens (77.61%) but96.63% of gross negative fixed-TIS action-mean contribution mass; it also contains93.57% of gross positive mass. Net thought contribution is negative while tool/control totals offset part of it. This is real numerical concentration in four selected actions, with strong cancellation, not attribution of a cause.
findings.tool_arguments: Quoted native string arguments contribute -2.38434278e-5, numeric arguments +1.13993967e-4, syntax/name -5.55935294e-5 under legacy fixed-TIS scaling; tool body overall is +3.45570094e-5. The selected data does not support saying all tool arguments worsened.
findings.normalization: The same saved matched deltas remain negative under scale128: no-IS direction -7.27212860e-5, fixed-TIS direction -2.68418426e-4. These are only unit/weight rescalings of the actual old vectors; no new-mode model was trained or scored.
findings.first4: All four old actions begin sampled <|channel>(100), thought(45518), newline(107), then the first body word. Current study probes first4 from the first action only. One body word can carry substantial drift, but no tool name/argument or later thought body is covered.
findings.attribution: Span-level finite logprob movement is not a causal decomposition of the parameter update or a proof of backward error. No post-grad vector is available.

predeclared_slots: first sampled tool-name token (fallback first tool-body)
middle sampled native quoted-string argument token (fallback tool-body middle)
middle sampled numeric argument token (fallback last sampled argument, then tool-body last)
superseded_single_action_draft_selection.rule: Choose only existing selected-token rows from raw native boundaries; use index quantiles and deduplicate, then restore temporal order. Never select by reward, delta size, gradient, or observed head discrepancy. Missing strata contribute no invented rows; cap remains8.
superseded_single_action_draft_selection.mapping: Use selected_index_0 for both actual predictor/target and current.grad coefficient selection; completion index alone is wrong when any forced mask gap exists.
superseded_single_action_draft_selection.current_coverage: Current numerics head study chooses first4 selected predictors from first action only. In all four short-r1 responses, these are channel-open, thought label, newline and the first thought word. They provide no tool-body/argument coverage.
superseded_single_action_draft_selection.limitation: A <=8-row isolated head slice still differs from the full focal fused-head shape and does not validate backbone gradients, CUDA kernels, an optimizer step, or task-level gains.
superseded_single_action_draft_selection.declaration_scope: Proposed deterministic rule for the still-pending future zero-update GPU study. Designed after examining this old pilot; it is not claimed preregistered before short-r1 or an independent validation.

pending_Tenacity_tokens_only_review.scope: Only completion IDs/masks, prompt length and branch ID used; no missing reference completed, no probability vector re-scored or changed.
pending_Tenacity_tokens_only_review.conclusion: Both first4 consist of channel-open100, lexical thought45518, newline107 and first thought token1509(It), with no tool-body coverage. The proposed rule yields4 valid selected rows in each action,8 total.
